prompts.corpses: Create an original DEADWALL 2D zombie fallen body sprite atlas, landscape 1536 by 1024, TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 5 evenly spaced rows and 4 evenly spaced columns, 20 equal cells with generous empty transparent gutters; all bodies fully isolated, no overlap, no labels or text, no ground, no cast shadows outside silhouette. STRICT DIRECT OVERHEAD TOP DOWN camera looking straight down at people LYING FLAT ON THE GROUND, NEVER upright. All bodies long axis horizontal, feet LEFT, head RIGHT, full human anatomy and clothing. Serious semi-realistic hand painted muted zombie survival game, recognizable human people, no fantasy mutations, no glowing eyes, no grotesque open organs, no severed limbs. Two distinct fallen positions per profile: first lies supine arms loose bent apart; second lies on side knees slightly folded one arm tucked. Each row shows TWO different zombie profiles, each profile in these TWO poses. Row 1 cells 1-2 ordinary walker wearing dirty brown jacket, faded gray pants; cells 3-4 recent runner in torn red running shirt and black track pants. Row 2 cells 1-2 armored police officer dark navy uniform tactical vest helmet; cells 3-4 crawler in torn pale shirt and worn gray shorts, arms extended slightly, ordinary intact human. Row 3 cells 1-2 howler in ragged faded light gray shirt and muted trousers; cells 3-4 breacher former construction worker wearing ochre hi-vis jacket and work boots. Row 4 cells 1-2 stalker in dark charcoal hoodie and faded olive trousers; cells 3-4 bloated heavy overweight HUMAN in stretched blue shirt and brown pants, no mutations. Row 5 cells 1-2 shielded riot police with black helmet, vest and a dark riot shield fallen next to but touching forearm; cells 3-4 charging recent infected in battered red-white sports jacket and black shorts. Bodies have death stillness with closed eyes and relaxed limbs, tiny restrained dried blood stains on clothing only. Each body fits central 300x130px of its 384x205px cell, stays horizontal, flesh remains muted gray brown, no cartoon, no standing or crawling alive poses.
prompts.heldA: Create a DEADWALL held firearm COMPONENT atlas for a game with TRUE TOP DOWN camera. Landscape 1536x1024, transparent. Exactly 4 rows x5 columns, equal cells with broad empty gutters. Absolutely NOT SIDE ELEVATION: triggers, pistol grips, magazine bodies and side triggerguards must NOT be visible because they are UNDER the receiver; visible silhouette is narrow aligned horizontal barrel/receiver/stock. No people, hands, backgrounds, text, muzzle flashes or loose objects. Stocks and rear handles LEFT, muzzle tips RIGHT. Receiver and long barrel lie along the horizontal central line of each cell. Underneath parts may only give tiny realistic protrusions to the outline, not large downward grips. Think overhead weapons laid flat on the floor with upper mechanical surface UP.
